comparison: Both evaluate the microscopy evidence for physical interaction between cancer cells and SCS macrophages (C3, C19-C24). OpenEval finds the evidence well-supported, while peer reviewers accepted the core finding but noted terminology concerns (contact vs adhesion). Both agree the spatial relationship is demonstrated.

Both address generalizability claims (C25, C26). OpenEval finds the claim appropriately cautious given limited 4T1 data, rating it SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rated it UNCERTAIN, expressing significant concern that 4T1 was only used in one experiment with no verification of the mechanism in other cell lines.

Perfect agreement on sialylation claims (C27-C33). Both find the lectin staining, flow cytometry, and sialidase experiments convincing. Peer reviewers noted a minor figure labeling issue but accepted the underlying data. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Significant disagreement on proliferation/survival mechanism (C34, C36-C41). OpenEval finds the Ki67, cleaved caspase-3, and co-culture data SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning biological relevance of flow cytometry shifts and requesting strong positive controls for pERK and pAKT, stating 'there is not much of a shift.'

Strong disagreement on AKT/ERK phosphorylation claims (C42-C44). OpenEval finds Phosflow data SUPPORTED as mechanistic link. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN with strong skepticism, stating 'very challenging to see how the pERK and pAKT are actually different in any meaningful way' and questioning robustness.

Agreement on RNA-seq data (C45-C51). Both find the transcriptomic analysis and pathway enrichment acceptable. OpenEval notes lack of clarity on multiple testing correction as limitation. Peer reviewers raised no specific concerns. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Agreement on PLK1 phosphorylation (C52-C54). Both accept the Phosflow data showing PLK1 activation. Peer reviewers requested minor axis labeling clarification but did not challenge validity. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Agreement on St3gal3 knockout experiments (C55-C69). Both find the CRISPR knockout, functional validation, and in vivo metastasis data convincing. Peer reviewers confirmed experiments ruled out cell-intrinsic effects and accepted the specificity for LN metastasis. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Agreement on the integrated model (C70, C71, C73, C74). Both find the overall mechanistic model consistent with experimental data and prior literature. Peer reviewers noted authors toned down claims appropriately. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Both address therapeutic implications (C75). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting it is speculative without therapeutic intervention studies. Peer reviewers include C75 in their SUPPORTED evaluation of the overall model, accepting it as a reasonable suggestion based on the data.

OpenEval evaluated background/context claims (C1, C2, C8-C18) as SUPPORTED by appropriate citations to prior literature. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, as peer reviewers typically focus on novel experimental claims rather than literature context.
OpenEval evaluated claim C72 about dual roles of SCS macrophages as SUPPORTED by prior literature citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this specific contextual claim.
